description: Arm matrix and preregistered primary comparisons for the DSH Hindsight tuner A/B eval. Gate ids (P0-P3) and arm names (R0-R2, A0-A5) are local naming conventions invented for this eval suite; they are not upstream API names. Every arm records the env it pins on top of the task env; anything that cannot be pinned by env alone is listed in `requires`.
notes: Use `node eval/ab.mjs --arms A0,A2,A3` to select names from this file by CSV, or `--arms <path-to-json>` for a custom matrix.
HINDSIGHT_AUTO_INJECT accepts none | pages | reflect | recall (lib/validate.js AUTO_INJECT_MODES).
Set HINDSIGHT_BANK_ID and HINDSIGHT_API_URL once per experiment; the bank fingerprint freezes one bank per run.

tunerSettings below documents the DSH plugin settings that must be pinned before the run (plugin profile config / lib/config-file.js). autoTune drift invalidates the arm; pin the values and record them with the report.
HINDSIGHT_EVAL_HINT is an eval-only convention: the agent command wrapper may read it to append the matching hint text to the prompt. It is metadata for the runner, not a plugin option.

P3 compares two bank states. Run each bank as its own experiment with its own frozen fingerprint, or set per-arm HINDSIGHT_BANK_ID inside arm.env (then the single fingerprint covers only the primary bank).
Tasks must not depend on wall-clock time, network access or unseeded randomness; keep checks deterministic (see eval/README.md).

gates.title: Failure feedback protocol
gates.question: Does structuring the failure information the agent receives reduce attempts to success compared with no hint or a raw error dump?
gates.notes: Memory is disabled in this gate; the hint is delivered by the agent wrapper via HINDSIGHT_EVAL_HINT.

gates.title: Memory source ablation
gates.question: Do Hindsight pages beat no memory and handwritten conventions, and how do they compare with reflect?
gates.notes: Preregistered primary comparison for the memory-source gate is A3 (native pages) vs A1 (handwritten conventions).

gates.title: Injection view / budget
gates.question: Within the same page memory, does the tuner truncation profile or the Budgeted View reduce cost per solved node without losing success?
gates.notes: A3 is the same native-pages baseline as P1. Secondary comparison of interest: A3-T vs A3.

gates.title: Fact provenance
gates.question: Do oracle-promoted facts outperform raw session facts at equal injection budget?
gates.notes: The two arms require differently seeded banks; see the note above about per-arm HINDSIGHT_BANK_ID and fingerprints.

arms.name: R0
arms.label: no hint
arms.description: Control: the agent gets the task prompt and its failing check output only, with no structured failure guidance.

arms.name: R1
arms.label: raw error
arms.description: The agent is shown the raw stderr/stdout of the failed check, unmodified.
arms.hypothesis: Raw output carries signal but also noise; may not beat no hint on attempts.
arms.hint: raw-error: append the check's raw output to the next attempt prompt
requires: agent wrapper must implement the raw-error hint

arms.name: R2
arms.label: structured pitfall
arms.description: The agent is shown a structured failure summary (failing check, failing assertion, locality, suspected pitfall) extracted by the wrapper.
arms.hypothesis: Structured failure information lowers attempts to success versus no hint and raw error.
arms.hint: structured-pitfall: append {check, assertion, file/locality, pitfall} JSON to the next attempt prompt
requires: agent wrapper must implement the structured-pitfall hint

arms.name: A0
arms.label: no memory
arms.description: Hindsight injection disabled; the agent works from the repository and task prompt alone.
arms.hypothesis: Floor: any memory benefit must exceed this arm's success rate.

arms.name: A1
arms.label: handwritten conventions
arms.description: Hindsight disabled; the fixture repository contains a handwritten AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md conventions file. This is the preregistered baseline for A3.
arms.hypothesis: Handwritten conventions are cheap and already available; Hindsight pages must beat them to justify the plugin.
arms.hint: none injected by the wrapper; conventions come from the fixture repo
requires: fixture repo contains the handwritten conventions file before the run

arms.name: A2
arms.label: reflect
arms.description: Hindsight reflect synthesis injected; the agent receives a consolidated reflection rather than retrieved pages.
arms.hypothesis: Reflect trades retrieval breadth for synthesis; may win on cheap tasks and lose on exact-locality tasks.

arms.name: A3
arms.label: pages (native)
arms.description: Hindsight Pages injected natively by the integration (viewPolicy=truncate, default pageSearchLimit). Preregistered treatment for A3 vs A1 and the P2 baseline.
arms.hypothesis: Pages provide the strongest locality-specific memory; should beat A1 at higher token cost.

arms.name: A3-T
arms.label: tuner truncation
arms.description: Same page memory as A3 but with the tuner's truncation profile pinned: reduced page search limit and long pages clipped before injection.
arms.hypothesis: Truncation lowers cost per solved node without lowering success versus native pages.
requires: pin the tuner plugin settings/viewPolicy=truncate before the run; env alone cannot express viewPolicy

arms.name: A3-V
arms.label: Budgeted View
arms.description: Same page memory and page search limit as A3-T, but the tuner spends the injection budget on scored facts via settings.viewPolicy=budgeted (lib/view.js) instead of clipping text.
arms.hypothesis: Budgeted View reduces tokens per injection and improves cost per solved node versus both A3 and A3-T at equal success.
requires: pin settings.viewPolicy=budgeted in the plugin profile config (or state.json) before the run

arms.name: A4
arms.label: oracle-promoted facts
arms.description: Bank seeded with oracle-promoted facts (curated, deduplicated, linked) before the run.
arms.hypothesis: Promoted facts improve memory precision and reduce false fact adoption versus raw session facts.
arms.hint: pages injection from the oracle bank
requires: seed the bank with oracle-promoted facts, let the bank settle, then capture the fingerprint
set the bank id via HINDSIGHT_BANK_ID in this arm's env when comparing two banks in one experiment

arms.name: A5
arms.label: raw session facts
arms.description: Bank seeded with raw session facts (unpromoted) at a comparable fact count.
arms.hypothesis: Raw facts retain noise and stale statements; should lose to A4 on false-fact adoption and precision.
arms.hint: pages injection from the raw bank
requires: seed the bank with raw session facts, let the bank settle, then capture the fingerprint
set the bank id via HINDSIGHT_BANK_ID in this arm's env when comparing two banks in one experiment
